clues.text: It was launched 16 days after its identical twin.
Its original mission was designed to last approximately five years.
It captured the first image showing Earth and the Moon together in a single frame.
Its trajectory was deliberately altered to allow it to visit Uranus and Neptune.
It carries a gold-plated copper disc containing greetings in 55 languages.
It became the most distant human-made object in existence before the end of the 20th century.
